answer_text: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN is shown in the Tunnel Timeline as an IPsec/IKEv2 issue. To review the event and what was negotiated, open the IPSec tab in the site, then use Timeline and download the CSV to inspect the entries. To determine the exact proposals being offered, use the built-in Packet Capture tool to capture the IKE/IPsec control traffic and review the transform sets and negotiation details; the captures can also surface mismatches (TS_UNACCEPTABLE) between subnets or transforms. If you’re debugging against a cloud provider, verify that the IPsec settings match the provider’s defaults (use the same settings in Cato as in the provider).
